title: An appetite larger than the means
odia: ଅରଜି ନପାରେ ମୁଣ୍ଡ, ସୁଆଦ ଲୋଡୁଚି ତୁଣ୍ଡ ।
literal_meaning: The head cannot earn; the mouth wants delicacies.
explanation: The line sets the head’s inability to earn against the mouth’s demand for tasty food. It can rebuke expectations of luxury that do not match available means or contribution. Its tone is sharp and can be hurtful when applied to someone whose circumstances are outside their control.
meaning_odia: ଆୟର ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ଅଳ୍ପ, କିନ୍ତୁ ରୁଚି ଓ ଚାହିଦା ବହୁତ—ଏହି ଅମେଳକୁ କଥାଟି କଟାକ୍ଷ କରେ। ନିଜ ସମ୍ବଳ ନଦେଖି ଅଧିକ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚର ଇଚ୍ଛା ରଖିବା ବେଳେ ଏହା କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ। ଏହାର ସ୍ୱର କଟୁ; ଅଭାବ ବା କାମ ନମିଳିବାକୁ ଲୋକର ଦୋଷ ବୋଲି ଧରିବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A group has agreed to a modest outing, but one member insists on an expensive feast while refusing to contribute. Another uses the saying to question that mismatch. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: ମୁଣ୍ଡ and ତୁଣ୍ଡ create a compact rhyme between earning and appetite. A possible related line in the1893 scan remains unverified; its uncertain wording is not presented here as a confirmed historical match.

english_summary: An appetite for luxury runs ahead of available means; the rebuke can sting.
